problem: The termination-above-supporting-structure branch is an unconditional alternative to attachment, so an upper end that merely terminates above an eligible structure can satisfy the rule. The requirement and semantic obligation require attachment to an eligible supporting structure; the at-or-above-ice-belt condition qualifies only the stated permissions and cannot replace the attachment requirement.
required_change: Require sh:hasAttachedSupportingStructure with minCount 1 and an eligible deckStructure, tankBoundaryPlating, or iceStringer for the upper end. Do not allow hasTerminationAboveSupportingStructure to satisfy that base requirement; if the exception is modeled, gate its separate permissions on supportingStructureAtOrAboveIceBeltUpperLimit.
regression_guard: Preserve unconditional attachment of the strengthened upper end; keep any termination-above-supporting-structure logic limited to the explicitly conditional permissions.
